data_fields.name: segmented_flag
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: any two outbound exits cannot reach each other on foot (type 5003, or 5005 with mobs)

best_idea: At build time, precompute for each zone the walk-step count from every visible service point to every arrival cell, plus a segmented flag, so the minimap can show steps to a service without a runtime search.
decision_why: A per-zone step table is cheap, data-driven and fits zones-as-data and the HUD minimap; reject the Lua output and the inadmissible heuristic, and fix the segmented check before use.
acceptance: On the HUD minimap, the nearest service in a test zone shows a step count within 1 step of a server-side walk search on the same grid; a zone whose walls split its exits is flagged segmented.
